description: This Swift source file defines the 'InstancesSettings' SwiftUI View, which displays a list of connected instances with their status, icons, and details. It includes methods for rendering each instance row, icons, status indicators, and handling user interactions. It also contains a debug extension for testing purposes.

methods.name: exerciseForTesting
methods.description: Provides sample data for testing the 'InstancesSettings' view in debug mode.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns the header view of the instances list, including the title and refresh button.

methods.name: instanceRow
methods.description: Constructs the view for a single instance entry in the list, including icons, status, and contextual actions.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Creates a labeled icon with optional system image, used to display version, device type, or platform.

methods.name: presenceIndicator
methods.description: Displays presence status as a colored dot and label based on activity age.

methods.name: presenceStatus
methods.description: Determines the presence label and color based on last activity timestamp.

methods.name: leadingDeviceIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon representing the device type or platform for an instance.

methods.name: leadingDeviceSymbol
methods.description: Decides which symbol to use for device icons based on device family and platform.

methods.name: shouldShowUpdateRow
methods.description: Determines if update information should be displayed for a given instance.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Returns a system symbol name if available; otherwise, returns a fallback symbol.

methods.name: isSystemSymbolAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a given system symbol exists in the current system.

methods.name: platformIcon
methods.description: Maps platform string to a system icon name.

methods.name: prettyPlatform
methods.description: Returns a human-readable platform name from a raw string.

methods.name: presenceUpdateSourceShortText
methods.description: Converts debug reasons into short, user-friendly labels.

methods.name: updateSummaryText
methods.description: Generates a string summarizing the age of last update and source for a given instance.

methods.name: presenceUpdateSourceHelp
methods.description: Provides help text explaining why a presence update was made.

methods.name: AndroidMark
methods.description: A custom SwiftUI View that renders an Android robot icon.
